adc_to_kev.method: coincidence_setting_anchor: electron energy lower limit 90 ADC == 30 keV electron threshold (proton/electron boundary); offset 0. Cross-checks: pulser mean 733 ADC (no keV ref stored); beta endpoint 782 keV == 2346 ADC at this scale (naive edge fit 4617 ADC rejected as pileup-obscured).

noise_amp_spectrum.note: Histogram of trigger energy_adc for single events (type==0), used as a noise+background proxy. Singles carry one trigger each; their energy distribution is dominated by low-energy noise/background triggers, not true physics signal.

notes: threshold source: /Parameters/FilterSettings.threshold per board-channel (bc), mapped bc->pixel via /Parameters/BoardChannelToPixelMap. tick_ns=4.0 ns from RunTime UTC/DAQ cross-check (4.004 ns) and coincidence '4ns bins'. calibration: 90 ADC == 30 keV electron threshold (DAQ coincidence setting) -> scale 0.33333 keV/ADC, offset 0; beta endpoint 782 keV == 2346.0 ADC at this scale (naive edge fit 4617.1 ADC rejected as pileup-obscured); pulser mean 733.0 ADC has no stored keV ref. median within-event min trigger spacing 20152.0 ns (min observed tick spacing 2 ticks = 8 ns). livetime from trigger timestamp span. dead=never-fires or threshold>=1000; hot=rate>10x median active rate (0.000534 /us).
